intro: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach us at hello@alexandris-demo.example.

questions.question: How long does delivery take?
questions.answer: Standard shipping arrives in 3–5 business days and is free on orders over €150 (€6.95 below that). Express shipping arrives in 1–2 business days for €14.95.

questions.question: Which countries do you ship to?
questions.answer: We currently ship within the EU and UK. Broader international shipping is on our roadmap.

questions.question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
questions.answer: Orders begin processing shortly after they're placed, so we can't guarantee changes once confirmed. Contact us as soon as possible and we'll do what we can.

questions.question: How do I track my order?
questions.answer: Sign in and open Account → Orders to see the current status of any order. You'll also get a shipping confirmation email once it leaves the warehouse.

questions.question: What's your return policy?
questions.answer: Unworn items with tags attached can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Start a return from Account → Returns. Items marked 'Final Sale' aren't eligible.

questions.question: Do you offer exchanges?
questions.answer: Not directly — return the item for a refund and place a new order for the size or colour you want, so you're not waiting on stock.

questions.question: How long do refunds take?
questions.answer: 5–7 business days after we receive and inspect your return, plus however long your bank takes to post the credit.

questions.question: How do I find my size?
questions.answer: Check the Size Guide, linked from every product page and in the site footer, for measurements by category.

questions.question: Are your products true to size?
questions.answer: Fit notes are listed on each product page. When a style runs small or large, we call it out there rather than only in the general size chart.

questions.question: What are your products made from?
questions.answer: Primarily full-grain leather and suede uppers on leather or rubber soles. Full material composition is listed on each product page. See our Sustainability page for how we source them.

questions.question: Do I need an account to order?
questions.answer: No — guest checkout is available. Creating an account lets you track orders, save addresses, and check out faster next time.

questions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal are shown at checkout. This is a demo store — no payment is actually charged.
